tips.mental: Inner state and emotions: meditation, journaling, rest for your mind, easing anxiety. E.g. “10 min of meditation”, “journaled my thoughts”.
tips.personal: Relationships and caring for yourself as a person: family, friends, home, personal joys, time for yourself. E.g. “called mom”, “cozy evening with a book”.
tips.work: Your main job: projects, tasks, meetings, deadlines, work results. E.g. “closed a big task”, “ran 3 meetings”.
tips.growth: Growing in your profession: studying, courses, books, new skills, networking. E.g. “English lesson”, “finished a course module”.
tips.insta: Your blog and professional reach: content, stories, shoots, reach, collabs. E.g. “filmed a reel”, “published a post”.
tips.sport: Movement and body care: workouts, gym, yoga, walks, stretching. E.g. “20-min workout”, “went to the gym”.
tips.food: Food and water: balanced meals, enough water, no overeating. E.g. “cooked at home”, “2 liters of water”.
